faqs.a: BCUs represent the AI processing power required to generate your applications. Every action — architecture planning, code generation, UI design, debugging, and testing — consumes BCUs. Simple apps use fewer BCUs; complex multi-feature platforms use more. The engine estimates BCU usage before starting every build.

faqs.q: Can I run multiple projects on one plan?
faqs.a: Yes — you can build as many projects as you want within your included BCUs. There's no per-project limit. Run one large project or ten small ones — it's entirely up to you.

faqs.q: What happens when my BCUs run out?
faqs.a: The engine will notify you before your BCUs are exhausted. You can then purchase a BCU top-up pack to continue building without changing your plan. Top-ups are available on Starter, Professional, and Team plans.
Yes — unused BCUs carry forward to the following month so you never lose compute you've paid for.
Yes — 100%. All source code, assets, and intellectual property generated for your build belong to you. We retain no rights to your code.

Enterprise plans are billed annually and priced by the number of users: 1 user at $4,999/year, 2–5 users at $6,999/year, 6–10 users at $8,999/year. Teams of 11 or more require a custom quote — contact us and we'll put together a proposal.
